evidence.robustness: Two orthogonal negative controls, both run and both quoted. (1) the reviewer's own edit -- obs_dome_2 z_m 7960 -> 7700 in blue_0_0_places.json -- now gives exit 1 and `verdict=FAIL handoff=PASS arrival=NONE`, naming blue_0_0_c04z12 and its inventory `(no place-tagged group at all)`. (2) `if true: continue` in the free loop gives `verdict=FAIL handoff=FAIL arrival=obs_dome_2@blue_0_0_c04z15 x108 groups`. The two failure modes are separable, which is the property the previous version lacked.
evidence.craft: Not a geometry item; scored as behaviour per AAA-STANDARD's CRAFT clause for subsystems with no geometry. A body walks 1,507.4 m across 20 cell hand-offs, 0 frames off the floor, max activate 3.3 ms, and arrives standing on 108 mesh groups of the named place.

what_is_good: the walk itself is real: 1,507.4 m of floor, 11 cells entered, 20 boundary crossings, resident peak 7 with a drawdown of 5
arrival is now a claim about triangles that exist, verified in the same frame the body is standing there
the budget overage is printed on every run with its ratio and frame count and is never implied by silence

findings.text: peak resident 359,584 tri against a 180,000 budget (2.00x) for 2,588 frames. Measured on ONE deck of 251 in the manifest / 71 in the register, which is one convenient case by definition. station/budget.py owns the number; --strict-budget puts it in an exit code.

1 deck baked of 251 in cell_manifest.json deck_table, 1 of 71 the register addresses; STATE.md records a 70-deck bake. NOTHING in the repository states the intended denominator, so the gate covers 1/71 of the addressed station however it passes.

the gate walks the 2.16 m axial spine only, and `_wiring` is null in it, so doors are solid trimeshes and no NPC, interactable or crowd is exercised on the traverse. It proves the streamer hands off; it does not prove the far cluster is a place worth arriving in.
